parkedExclusions.reason: SRAC protocol framing — assertions are protocol-specific (adrenochrome-based complexes proposed to suppress NF-kB-driven SASP), not established general biology; conflicts with the pro-inflammatory/redox-active characterization elsewhere in the corpus (see conflict T2-2).
parkedExclusions.reason_zh_TW: SRAC 協定架構——主張屬協定專屬（提議以腎上腺素紅為基礎的複合物抑制 NF-kB 驅動的 SASP），並非普遍生物學；與語料庫其他處的促發炎／氧化還原活性描述相矛盾（見衝突 T2-2）。

scenarios.title: Triples Human-Review — Adrenochrome / Mitohormesis / Autophagy / Sirtuins
scenarios.description: Decision points distilled from the Tier 1–3 triples review report. Pick a stance per conflict and re-run graph analyses against the modified edge set.

conflicts.title: Adrenochrome is_a Aminochrome — class membership vs molecule identity
conflicts.summary: Aminochrome is specifically the oxidation product of dopamine; adrenochrome is the corresponding product of epinephrine. As written, is_a asserts identity between two distinct molecules — the source context means adrenochrome belongs to the aminochrome class of compounds. Collides with the other is_a edges on this 69-degree hub.

evidence.label: is_a
evidence.context: Adrenochrome is an aminochrome, the class of oxidized, colored products formed from catecholamines. Aminochromes, specifically adrenochrome, are examined here as candidate senotherapeutics, and their chemistry, ortho-quinone electrophilicity and redox …
evidence.context_zh_TW: 腎上腺素色素是一種氨基色素，即由兒茶酚胺形成的氧化有色產物類。氨基色素，特別是腎上腺素色素，在此被研究為候選衰老治療藥物，其化學性質、鄰醌親電性和氧化還原循環決定了其潛在的溶細胞和衰老模仿活性，以及其神經毒性和心臟毒性。作為兒茶酚胺如腎上腺素和多巴胺的氧化產物，氨基色素是內源性壓力代謝物，在氧化條件下積累。

evidence.label: is_a
evidence.context: Adrenochrome is a chemical compound formed by the oxidation of epinephrine (adrenaline), a catecholamine stress hormone. In humans it arises as a minor oxidative metabolite or byproduct rather than through a dedicated biosynthetic pathway. Oxidation converts …
evidence.context_zh_TW: Adrenochrome 是由兒茶酚胺壓力荷爾蒙 epinephrine（adrenaline）氧化形成的化學化合物。在人體中，它是作為次要的氧化代謝物或副產物出現，而非透過專一的生物合成途徑。氧化將腎上腺素的兒茶酚環轉化為 o-quinone，隨後內部環化形成 indoline-5,6-dione 結構。此過程在體內由超氧陰離子與過氧化氫等活性氧物種驅動，亦發生於體外。由於此反應與主要的 COMT 與 MAO 降解途徑競爭，adrenochrome 形成在氧化壓力、發炎以及腎上腺素濃度高的情況下更為顯著，且被視為恆定失調的標記，而非正常的豐富產物。

options.label: Keep as class membership
options.detail: Read is_a loosely (aminochrome class of compounds). No edit.
options.detail_zh_TW: 將 is_a 寬鬆解讀為「氨基色素類化合物」。不做修改。

options.label: Remove — distinct molecules
options.detail: Identity is already covered by is_a → oxidation_product_of_epinephrine; the aminochrome edge stays removed.
options.detail_zh_TW: 身分已由 is_a → 腎上腺素氧化產物 涵蓋；氨基色素邊維持移除。

options.label: Recast as class membership edge
options.detail: Drop the identity claim, add an explicit class-membership edge instead.

add.label: is_class_member_of
add.context: Adrenochrome belongs to the aminochrome class (catecholamine oxidation products); class membership, not molecule identity.
add.context_zh_TW: 腎上腺素紅屬於氨基色素類（兒茶酚胺氧化產物）；這是類別成員關係，而非分子身分。

options.detail_zh_TW: 移除身分主張，改加入明確的類別成員邊。

conflicts.title_zh_TW: 腎上腺素紅 is_a 氨基色素——類別歸屬 vs 分子身分
conflicts.summary_zh_TW: 氨基色素（aminochrome）是多巴胺的氧化產物，而腎上腺素紅是腎上腺素的對應氧化產物。is_a 邊等於主張兩個不同分子是同一物——來源語境想說的其實是「腎上腺素紅屬於氨基色素類化合物」。這也與這個 69 度樞紐上的其他 is_a 邊相互衝突。

conflicts.title: Adrenochrome detectability: never detected vs detected in synovial fluid
conflicts.summary: Direct cross-paper conflict: one source states adrenochrome has never been detected in biological fluids (central to its controversial clinical significance); another reports detection in rheumatoid synovial fluid. Likely resolution: undetectable systemically in health, detectable locally under high-oxidative inflammatory conditions.

evidence.label: is_undetectable_in
evidence.context: Despite decades of interest in the adrenochrome pathway, adrenochrome has never been detected in biological fluids, and no established method for its formation in vivo has been demonstrated; this is the central reason the clinical significance of the compound …
evidence.context_zh_TW: 儘管數十年來對 adrenochrome 途徑感興趣，adrenochrome 從未在生物液體中被檢測到，也尚未建立證明其在體內形成的既成方法；這是該化合物臨床意義仍具爭議性的核心原因。檢測的困難與該分子的化學性質一致，包括其在水溶液中的不穩定性與短半衰期、迅速聚合成 melanins，以及對蛋白質和 DNA 的反應性，這些都會阻止其累積。體內形成最強的證據是間接的，例如在富含中性粒細胞的生物液體中檢測到與 adrenochrome 具有相同 HPLC 滯留時間的化合物，以及心肌梗塞後血清中出現氧化酶活性。然而，它明顯不存在於生物液體中，助長了對該途徑是否在人類疾病中真正重要的懷疑。

evidence.label: detected_in
evidence.context: Researchers have detected adrenochrome-like compounds in neutrophil-rich fluids such as synovial fluid from rheumatoid arthritis patients, where neutrophil activation and ROS release are prominent. This suggests a role for neutrophil-mediated catecholamine …
evidence.context_zh_TW: Researchers已在neutrophil-rich fluids中，例如rheumatoid arthritis患者的synovial fluid，detected adrenochrome-like compounds，此處neutrophil activation與ROS release顯著。這suggests a role for neutrophil-mediated catecholamine oxidation in inflammatory或stress-related conditions，且有一項study proposed它可能是inflammatory diseases中adrenaline的potential catabolic route。在此類fluids中detected的adrenochrome reflects inflammation部位catecholamines的local oxidation，consistent with the observation that activated neutrophils的cell-free medium retains adrenaline-oxidizing ability。

options.label: Keep both — qualified reading
options.detail: Undetectable systemically; detectable locally under oxidative inflammation. Both edges stay.
options.detail_zh_TW: 全身性無法檢出；局部氧化發炎下可檢出。兩個邊都保留。

options.label: Never detectable
options.detail: Favor the systemic claim; remove the synovial-fluid detection.
options.detail_zh_TW: 採納全身性主張；移除滑液檢出。

options.label: Local detection wins
options.detail: Remove the blanket undetectability claim; keep the synovial-fluid detection.
options.detail_zh_TW: 移除「全面無法檢出」主張；保留滑液檢出。

conflicts.title_zh_TW: 腎上腺素紅的可檢出性：從未檢出 vs 於關節滑液檢出
conflicts.summary_zh_TW: 直接的跨文獻矛盾：一篇文獻指出腎上腺素紅從未在生物體液中檢出（這是其臨床意義具爭議性的核心）；另一篇則報告在類風濕性關節炎滑液中檢出。可能的調和解讀：健康狀態下全身體液無法檢出，但在高氧化壓力的發炎環境中可局部檢出。

conflicts.title: Autophagy impairs Parkinson's Disease — inverted predicate direction
conflicts.summary: Autophagy does not impair PD; autophagic dysfunction contributes to PD. The source context itself admits the phrasing can be misread. Attached to the Autophagy (43°) and Parkinson's Disease (39°) hubs, this corrupts any BFS/path answer about autophagy–neurodegeneration. The correct protective edge (autophagy protects_against alpha-synuclein aggregation) already exists.

evidence.label: impairs
evidence.source: _document_ - Neuromelanin, aging, and neuronal vulnerability in Parkinson's disease.md
evidence.context: Autophagy impairs Parkinson's Disease when its deficiency or dysfunction weakens the target pathway. Mechanistically, reduced flux through the impaired system permits aggregate and organelle buildup that drives degeneration. This is significant because …
evidence.context_zh_TW: 當 Autophagy 的缺陷或功能障礙削弱目標途徑時，Autophagy 就會損害 Parkinson's Disease。從機制上講，通過受損系統的通量減少會導致聚集體和細胞器積聚，從而導致退化。這很重要，因為降解或能量途徑的損害是 Parkinson's disease 發病機制的核心特徵。需要注意的是，措辭可能會被誤讀。第一個實體的喪失或功能障礙是有害的，過度的活動也可能是有害的。

evidence.label: protects_against
evidence.context: Autophagy protects against Alpha-Synuclein Aggregation by neutralizing, scavenging, or removing the threatening species or condition. Mechanistically, Autophagy acts as a sink or reductant that limits oxidative, toxic, or aggregate burden within …
evidence.context_zh_TW: Autophagy 透過中和、清除或消除威脅物種或狀況來防禦 Alpha-Synuclein Aggregation。從機制上講，Autophagy 充當水槽或還原劑，限制兒茶酚胺能神經元內的氧化、毒性或聚集負擔。這種保護作用很重要，因為它可以解釋為什麼色素神經元在高代謝壓力（至少低於致病閾值）下仍能存活。需要注意的是，這種保護是有條件的；在過載、氧化還原擾動或 iron 釋放同一實體的情況下，可能會造成損害而不是預防。

options.label: Remove the inverted edge
options.detail: Drop it; the existing protects_against → alpha_synuclein_aggregation edge carries the protective direction.
options.detail_zh_TW: 直接移除；既有的 protects_against → α-突觸核蛋白聚集 邊已承載保護方向。

options.label: Recast: autophagy is impaired in PD
options.detail: Replace with a well-formed dysfunction claim using the existing disease node.

add.label: is_impaired_in
add.context: Autophagic dysfunction contributes to Parkinson's Disease pathology; autophagy itself is impaired in the disease.
add.context_zh_TW: 自噬功能失調促成帕金森氏症的病理；自噬本身在該病中是受損的。

options.label_zh_TW: 改寫：自噬在帕金森氏症中受損
options.detail_zh_TW: 以既有疾病節點改寫成語境正確的功能失調主張。

options.label: Keep as-is
options.detail: Leave the edge untouched (not recommended — the context field concedes the misreading).
options.detail_zh_TW: 不建議——來源語境自己承認措辭會被誤讀。

conflicts.title_zh_TW: 自噬損害帕金森氏症——述詞方向顛倒
conflicts.summary_zh_TW: 自噬不會損害帕金森氏症；是自噬功能失調促成帕金森氏症。來源語境自己也承認這個措辭容易被誤讀。此邊掛在自噬（43 度）與帕金森氏症（39 度）兩個樞紐上，會污染任何關於自噬–神經退化的 BFS／路徑答案。正確的保護方向邊（自噬保護免受 α-突觸核蛋白聚集）已存在。

conflicts.title: Rapamycin and the immune system: suppresses vs reverses immunosenescence
conflicts.summary: Classic conflicting-views case. mTOR inhibition is immunosuppressive (transplant literature) yet improves immune function in aged animals (immunosenescence reversal). Both edges are individually defensible but contradictory without an age-context qualifier. Unresolved, downstream queries return whichever document was traversed last.

evidence.label: suppresses
evidence.source: _document_ - Rapamycin for longevity the pros, the cons, and future perspectives.md
evidence.context: In clinical settings, rapamycin's immunosuppressive mechanisms increase infection risk and impair wound healing, especially in otherwise healthy individuals without clinical manifestations that outweigh the risk of side effects. Some early clinical studies …
evidence.context_zh_TW: 在臨床環境中，rapamycin的免疫抑製機制增加感染風險並損害傷口癒合，特別是在其他方面健康、沒有臨床表現的個體中，其風險超過副作用的風險。一些早期臨床研究表明，短期rapamycin或rapalogs可能改善老年人免疫功能的某些方面，但這些研究依賴於對流感疫苗接種的血清學反應，這對更廣泛的免疫能力的預測價值有限。更廣泛的措施，包括T細胞庫多樣性、先天免疫活性和現實世界的感染抵抗力，仍然研究不足。

evidence.label: delays
evidence.context: Rapamycin delays immune aging by inhibiting mTORC1, an intervention shown to restore hematopoietic stem cell function and enhance the generation and persistence of memory CD8+ T cells in aged subjects. Mechanistically, mTORC1 inhibition shifts lymphocytes …
evidence.context_zh_TW: Rapamycin透過抑制mTORC1來延緩免疫老化，此介入已被證明可恢復造血幹細胞功能並增強老年個體中記憶性CD8+ T細胞的生成與持續。在機制上，mTORC1抑制將淋巴細胞推向更初始、較不耗竭的狀態，並促進免疫細胞內自噬介導的品質控制。在臨床前和臨床研究中，短暫的rapamycin治療改善了老年人對疫苗的免疫反應。這些效應說明了標靶mTOR—自噬軸如何能在功能上使老化的免疫系統恢復年輕。

options.label: Immunostimulatory in aged animals
options.detail: Keep the immunosenescence-reversal edge; remove the systemic immunosuppression edge.
options.label_zh_TW: 對老年動物具免疫刺激性
options.detail_zh_TW: 保留免疫老化逆轉邊；移除全身性免疫抑制邊。

options.label: Immunosuppressive
options.detail: Keep the transplant-context suppression edge; remove the immune-aging edge.
options.detail_zh_TW: 保留移植語境的抑制邊；移除免疫老化邊。

options.label: Keep both — context-dependent
options.detail: The disagreement is the scientifically valuable content: suppression in transplant settings, restoration in aged animals.
options.detail_zh_TW: 矛盾本身正是有價值的科學內容：移植情境下抑制，老年動物中恢復。

conflicts.title_zh_TW: 雷帕霉素與免疫系統：抑制 vs 逆轉免疫老化
conflicts.summary_zh_TW: 經典的觀點衝突案例。mTOR 抑制具免疫抑制作用（移植文獻），但在老年動物中能改善免疫功能（免疫老化逆轉）。兩個邊各自都有依據，但缺少年齡語境限定時相互矛盾。不處理的話，下游查詢會回傳「最後被遍歷到的那份文獻」的說法。

conflicts.title: SOD / Catalase inhibit Adrenochrome — mis-extracted predicate
conflicts.summary: Context shows SOD and catalase inhibit the oxidation of adrenaline → adrenochrome by scavenging neutrophil ROS — not adrenochrome itself. Predicate mis-extraction on a 69-degree hub.

evidence.label: inhibits
evidence.context: Superoxide dismutase (SOD), along with catalase and azide, inhibits the oxidation of adrenaline to adrenochrome in experiments with stimulated neutrophils, confirming that reactive oxygen species are responsible for the conversion. SOD specifically scavenges …
evidence.context_zh_TW: Superoxide dismutase（SOD）與catalase及azide一同，在stimulated neutrophils的experiments中inhibits adrenaline oxidation to adrenochrome，confirming that reactive oxygen species are responsible for the conversion。SOD specifically scavenges由neutrophil NADPH oxidase system生成的superoxide radicals，而由於這些radicals驅動了大部分的adrenaline oxidation（在低micromolar concentrations下超過80%），removing them blocks adrenochrome formation。此enzyme-based inhibition是neutrophil-mediated adrenochrome production的ROS-dependent mechanism的key experimental evidence。

evidence.label: inhibits
evidence.context: Catalase, along with superoxide dismutase and azide, inhibits the oxidation of adrenaline to adrenochrome in stimulated-neutrophil experiments, confirming that reactive oxygen species mediate the conversion. Catalase scavenges hydrogen peroxide, which both is …
evidence.context_zh_TW: Catalase與superoxide dismutase及azide一同，在stimulated-neutrophil experiments中inhibits adrenaline oxidation to adrenochrome，confirming that reactive oxygen species mediate the conversion。Catalase scavenges hydrogen peroxide，而hydrogen peroxide本身既是一種reactive oxygen species，亦作為myeloperoxidase的substrate。由於hydrogen peroxide與myeloperoxidase-driven oxidation與superoxide一同contribute to catecholamine oxidation，catalase-mediated inhibition demonstrates that在此system中驅動adrenaline-to-adrenochrome conversion的是完整的ROS cascade，而非single species。

options.label: Recast as formation-prevention
options.detail: Remove both inhibits edges; add explicit prevents_formation_of edges via superoxide scavenging.

add.label: prevents_formation_of
add.context: SOD limits adrenaline oxidation to adrenochrome by scavenging neutrophil-derived superoxide.
add.context_zh_TW: SOD 藉由清除中性球衍生的超氧化物，限制腎上腺素氧化為腎上腺素紅。

add.label: prevents_formation_of
add.context: Catalase limits adrenaline oxidation to adrenochrome by scavenging neutrophil-derived peroxide.
add.context_zh_TW: 過氧化氫酶藉由清除中性球衍生的過氧化物，限制腎上腺素氧化為腎上腺素紅。

options.detail_zh_TW: 移除兩個 inhibits 邊；加入明確的 prevents_formation_of 邊（經超氧化物清除）。

options.label: Keep as-is
options.detail: Leave the inhibits edges untouched.
options.detail_zh_TW: 保留 inhibits 邊。

conflicts.title_zh_TW: SOD／過氧化氫酶抑制腎上腺素紅——述詞誤萃取
conflicts.summary_zh_TW: 語境顯示 SOD 與過氧化氫酶是透過清除中性球 ROS 來抑制「腎上腺素氧化為腎上腺素紅」的過程——而非抑制腎上腺素紅本身。這是掛在 69 度樞紐上的述詞誤萃取。

conflicts.title: Adrenochrome inhibits NF-κB — speculative hypothesis at face value
conflicts.summary: Lowest-confidence edge on the 55-degree NF-κB hub (0.5). Source is explicitly hypothetical (SRAC protocol framing: 'proposes… could permanently inhibit… plausible route') and contradicts the pro-inflammatory/redox-active characterization elsewhere — adrenochrome induces oxidative stress and modifies the IKK complex in the same corpus.

evidence.label: inhibits
evidence.context: Contested senomorphic hypothesis: in the SRAC/adrenochrome-protocol framing, adrenochrome-based complexes are proposed to suppress NF-kB-driven SASP, hence 'Adrenochrome inhibits NF-kB'. This is a protocol-specific assertion, NOT general biology - broadly, …
evidence.context_zh_TW: 具爭議的衰老相關分泌表型（senomorphic）假說：在 SRAC／腎上腺素紅協定架構中，主張以腎上腺素紅為基礎的複合物可抑制 NF-kB 驅動的 SASP，故謂「腎上腺素紅抑制 NF-kB」。此為協定專屬主張，並非普遍生物學——廣義而言，氧化壓力（腎上腺素紅生成的背景）會活化 NF-kB，進而驅動 SASP／發炎（見 Oxidative Stress --activates--> NF-kB）。信心值下調以反映其爭議性。

evidence.label: induces
evidence.context: Through catalytic redox cycling, adrenochrome continuously regenerates its quinone form while reducing oxygen to superoxide, thereby fueling oxidative stress in exposed cells. Because the quinone is not consumed, aminochrome redox cycling amplifies reactive …
evidence.context_zh_TW: 通過催化氧化還原循環，腎上腺素色素持續再生其醌形式，同時將氧氣還原為超氧陰離子，從而在暴露細胞中 fuel 氧化應激。由於醌未被消耗，氨基色素氧化還原循環將活性氧產生放大遠超化學計量。在健康細胞中，NQO1的雙電子還原為穩定的氫醌繞過此循環，但NQO1和GSTM2活性低的細胞，如衰老細胞，假定選擇性脆弱。

evidence.label: modifies
evidence.context: Aminochromes such as adrenochrome can covalently modify the IKK complex (IkappaB kinase), a key upstream activator of NF-kappaB, via Michael addition to critical cysteine residues. IKK relies on cysteine residues for its activation, so alkylation would impair …
evidence.context_zh_TW: 氨基色素如腎上腺素色素可通過麥克爾加成共價修飾IKK複合物（IκB激酶），NF-κB的關鍵上游激活因子，針對關鍵半胱氨酸殘基。IKK依賴半胱氨酸殘基進行激活，因此烷基化會損害其激酶功能並阻止NF-κB的磷酸化依賴性激活。通過禁用此上游調節因子，假定低濃度的腎上腺素色素抑制NF-κB驅動的SASP轉錄，將衰老細胞轉變為較少炎症的衰老模仿狀態，而非直接殺死。

options.label: Remove — speculation, contradicted context
options.detail: Keep the established oxidative-stress/IKK edges only.
options.label_zh_TW: 移除——推測性且語境矛盾
options.detail_zh_TW: 只保留既有的氧化壓力／IKK 邊。

options.label: Keep — track the hypothesis
options.detail: Retain the low-confidence edge so the contested hypothesis is represented.
options.detail_zh_TW: 保留低信心邊，讓這個有爭議的假說在圖上有立足點。

conflicts.title_zh_TW: 腎上腺素紅抑制 NF-κB——推測性假說當作事實
conflicts.summary_zh_TW: NF-κB 這個 55 度樞紐上信心值最低的邊（0.5）。來源明確是假說性質（SRAC 協定架構：「提議……可能永久抑制……合理路徑」），且與語料庫其餘部分對腎上腺素紅的促發炎／氧化還原活性描述相矛盾——同一語料中腎上腺素紅會誘導氧化壓力並修飾 IKK 複合體。

conflicts.title: Mitohormesis requires Heart Rate Variability — biomarker as requirement
conflicts.summary: Context describes HRV as a recovery-monitoring biomarker that correlates with successful adaptation — not a mechanistic requirement. High confidence (0.92) makes this especially dangerous for traversal-based answers.

evidence.label: requires
evidence.context: Mitohormesis is about the dose-response relationship to stress, applying acute stressors such as exercise, fasting, and heat or cold to trigger mitochondrial adaptation. However, mitochondrial adaptation does not happen during the stressor; it happens during …

evidence.label: can_promote
evidence.context: In established tumors and chronically, senescence can paradoxically promote cancer through its SASP, which is rich in growth factors, angiogenic cues, and EMT-inducing cytokines. The SASP can stimulate survival, therapy resistance, cancer stemness, and immune …

evidence.label: can_promote
evidence.context: In established tumors, paracrine senescence from therapy-induced senescent (TIS) cells can promote cancer progression via a tumor-supportive SASP rich in growth factors and EMT inducers. The spread of senescence-associated remodeling can enhance stemness, …
evidence.context_zh_TW: 在已建立腫瘤中，來自治療誘發衰老（TIS）細胞的旁分泌衰老可透過富含生長因子與 EMT 誘發因子的促腫瘤 SASP 促進癌症進展。衰老相關重塑的擴散可增強鄰近惡性細胞的幹性、侵襲性與治療抗藥性，且慢性 SASP（IL-6、IL-8 經 JAK/STAT3）擴大癌症幹細胞特徵。此雙重性反映衰老與癌症整體的兩面關係。促進效應取決於 SASP 組成與免疫脈絡。
